# The Meltemi family: repositories, domains and contracts

Meltemi is one brand with two products and one web. Each lives in its own repository
([decision 0001](decisions/0001-family-repositories.md)).

| Repository       | Holds                                      |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| Meltemi IDE      | The agentic IDE                            |
| Meltemi Diagrams | The `.meltemi` language and its tools      |
| Meltemi Web      | The site, the identity service and the IaC |

The [decisions](decisions/) explain why.
